objective: independent fixed-rule four-bank monthly cross-sectional momentum candidate

rule.signal: first observed trading session of each calendar month, at T close
rule.factor: adjusted close(T) / adjusted close(T-60 trading sessions) - 1
rule.ranking: descending 60-session total return; fixed Top2, equal-weight targets
rule.execution: T+1 open; shared audited cash ledger, 100-share lots, 1% signal-day amount capacity, one-price limit locks, 3bp slippage, commission/transfer/sell stamp fees
rule.matched_benchmark_interpretation: cost/execution friction only on the same realized holdings path; not stock-selection alpha

research_engine_provenance: audited account_sim, fee, limit-type and summary functions copied into the local account_engine.py; no V3 temporary path is needed by run.py
